servinfo.title: ISG Removal and Installation

attention2.ptxt: Servicing SHVS system involves a danger of electric shock.
For precaution, detect the terminal voltage and use insulation tool and gloves.

attention4.ptxt: The ISG consists of precision parts. Without taking the following precautions, it may lose its original performance.

item.ptxt: Do not drop or expose the ISG to large shock.

servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following procedure, observe Precautions for Handling ISG:K14D .

s1.ptxt: Set ignition “OFF”, and keep ignition “OFF” for 3 minutes.
Disconnect negative (–) cable at battery.
Hoist vehicle and remove engine undercover and right side engine under side cover.
Remove accessory drive belt.
Remove radiator cooling fan assembly.
With A/C hoses connected, detach A/C compressor from cylinder block, and disconnect magnet clutch lead wire connector.

attention4.ptxt: When A/C compressor is detached, the A/C hoses could be damaged receiving weight of the compressor.
Suspend the removed A/C compressor to the vehicle body while the compressor is detached.

s1.ptxt: Remove accessory drive belt lower tensioner.
Detach harness clamps (1) and ISG connector (2).
Remove terminal cover (1), and check terminal voltage between “48V+” (2) and “48V–” (3) is lower than 5V.

attention3.ptxt: If the voltage is still higher than 5V, check it again in 15 minutes.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect “48V–” terminal wire.
Disconnect “48V+” terminal wire.
Remove ISG bolts (1).
Remove ISG (2) from vehicle.
Remove ISG bracket (1), if necessary.
Remove harness bracket (1) and suction hose stay (2), if necessary.
Install harness bracket and suction hose stay as follows, if removed.

s2.ptxt: Touch bracket stopper (1) to ISG and tighten bolt (2) to specified torque.
Set suction hose stay to its original position and tighten bolt (3) securely.

s1.ptxt: Tighten ISG bracket bolts (1), if removed.
Install ISG (1) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Put ISG on cylinder block and tighten new ISG bolts (2) temporarily.
Tighten ISG bolts to 30 N·m (3.1 kgf-m, 22.5 lbf-ft) and check that bushings (3) in ISG bracket are in contact with ISG bracket and cylinder block, and then loosen the bolts.
Tighten ISG bolts in numerical order (“1” – “2”) to specified torque.

s1.ptxt: Connect “48V+” terminal wire and tighten “48V+” terminal nut (1) to specified torque.
Connect “48V–” terminal wire and tighten “48V–” terminal nut (2) to specified torque.
Install terminal cover (3) to ISG ground terminal wire.
Fit harness clamps (1) and connect ISG connector (2).
Install accessory drive belt lower tensioner.
Install A/C compressor to cylinder block, and connect magnet clutch lead wire connector.
Install radiator cooling fan assembly.
Install accessory drive belt.
Install engine undercover and right side engine under side cover.
Connect negative (–) cable at battery.
After ISG is replaced with new one, perform ECM / ISG Registration using SUZUKI scan tool.
However, when ISG and BCM are replaced at the same time, perform BCM Registration for their registration.
